result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Neither answer plots running totals by month, so both miss the time axis. Each uses a single stacked progress bar, though both note the Jan–Sep period and the even-pace benchmark. A has a title that states the finding, direct labels on the segments, a goal line, a pace marker and a correct totals table, but its '$256k raised' headline overlaps the 'of $300k goal' text. B has correct figures and direct labels, but it adds a separate legend, its title is descriptive rather than a finding, and its dark theme suits a printed board packet poorly. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers show a single bar of year-to-date totals instead of running totals by month, so neither has a January–September time axis. Both have correct figures ($256k, 126/81/49, 85%). B is stronger: its title states the finding, it labels the donor groups directly, it draws the goal clearly and marks the even-pace reference ($225k for 9 of 12 months) on the chart. B has a small flaw where the '$256k raised' text overlaps 'of $300k goal'. A's title is descriptive rather than a finding, it relies partly on a legend, and the pace comparison appears only in the text.
